name: AnimatedList-TS-TW
title: AnimatedList
description: A tall column of short status messages in rounded dark rows scrolls inside a fixed panel, with rows fading at the top and bottom. Hovering a row brightens it and arrow keys walk the selection.
use: A compact panel should show many short updates or options in a scrollable column.
avoid: Long text or images per row: the 500px width and 400px height clip content.
a11y: Arrow keys and Enter work, but rows are plain divs with no roles and a global key hook, and motion ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A narrow column of rounded charcoal rows, each holding one line of white text, sits centred on black. The first and last rows fade into the background and one row is a shade lighter than the rest.
behaves: The list scrolls vertically inside a fixed height while its top and bottom rows soften out. Moving the pointer or pressing arrow keys walks a highlight down the rows, and clicking one selects it.
customise: Items, a select handler, gradients, arrow-key navigation, scrollbar, class names and the initial selection are props. Row colours are hardcoded dark values.
weight: light: A dozen text rows with simple in-view scale tweens.
demo: Status lines like "Invoice #4021 paid by Northwind Labs" and "Production deploy succeeded in 42s".
issues: The top and bottom rows are heavily faded, so edge items are hard to read.
polishWhy: Tidy dark rows and smooth fades; it is a standard list with little identity.
